m: īh cl. 1. Ā. īhate, īhāṃ-cakre, īhiṣyate, īhitum, rarely P. īhati, &c., to endeavour to obtain; to aim at, attempt; to long for, desire; to take care of; to have in mind, think of (with acc.), MBh.; R.; BhP.; Bhag.; Pañcat. &c. : Caus. īhayati, to impel.
a: īh 1 A. (īhate, īhāṃcakre, aihiṣṭa, īhiṣyate, īhituṃ, īhita) 1 To wish, desire, long for; have in mind, think of (with acc. or inf.); īhaṃte… arthasaṃcayān Bg. 16. 12, 7. 22; Ms. 4. 15, 3. 126; aihiṣṭa taṃ kārayituṃ kṛtātmā Bk. 1. 11. 2 To endeavour to obtain. 3 To aim at or attempt, endeavour, strive; mādhuryaṃ madhubiṃdunā racayituṃ kṣārāṃbudherīhate Bh. 2. 6; Y. 2. 116. 4 To take care of. — Caus. To impel, urge.
